date_semantics.release: Application and dataset release version (semantic versioning). Changes with code or data.
date_semantics.data_version: Version of the dataset content, YYYY.MM.DD.n by the date the curated inputs were last changed.
date_semantics.generated: Date the curated inputs that produced this file were last changed. Not a verification date.
date_semantics.evidence_review_date: Date of the most recent evidence-review pass. It does NOT mean every record was verified on that date; each claim carries its own checked date.
date_semantics.checked: On a claim: the date someone last compared that claim against the cited evidence. null = never checked.
date_semantics.source_published / source_effective: On a source: the document's own publication or effective date, when the document states one. Never a search date or a website footer year.
date_semantics.source_accessed: On a source: when the evidence was retrieved or observed, and through which access method.
date_semantics.as_of: On CMS reference data: the CMS snapshot month the row comes from.

scope: Hospital campuses in Washington, Alaska, Idaho, Montana and Wyoming (WWAMI): every Medicare-certified short-term acute-care, critical-access and children's hospital in the CMS Hospital General Information October 2023 snapshot for the five states, plus curated campuses the census cannot supply (military, shared-CCN campuses, facilities identified in the evidence review), and former names of renamed or merged campuses kept as search aliases; a campus is recorded as closed only when a licensing or CMS source confirms it. Receiving centers just outside the five states are included as destinations only. The CMS snapshot is the census denominator; facilities opened after it are present only where the review identified them.

eligibility_rule.label: Adult emergency-stroke analysis set
eligibility_rule.eligible: Active campus AND a general emergency department open 24/7 AND serving adults (all ages or adult). The emergency department may be documented for the campus or inferred from a program requirement the campus is subject to: Critical Access Hospital conditions of participation (42 CFR 485.618) or Washington stroke Level II designation criteria. Each record's eligibility reason says which.
eligibility_rule.excluded: Closed or merged campus; OR documented absence of a general 24/7 emergency department; OR a pediatric-only hospital. Each exclusion carries its reason.
eligibility_rule.unknown: Anything else: eligibility is unresolved until the missing evidence is found. Unknown is not excluded and not eligible.
eligibility_rule.note: Name alone never excludes a hospital (e.g. 'Clinic' in a name).

crosswalk_note: Display crosswalk only. A state stroke level is drawn on the national tier ladder so it can be coloured and filtered alongside national certifications. It does not mean the hospital holds, or meets the standards of, the national certification of that tier. National certification takes precedence for display when both exist.

claim_states.affirmative: Positive evidence for the claim (see sources and checked date).
claim_states.negative: Verified absent within a stated scope and date (e.g. not on a named registry revision).
claim_states.no-record-found: Searched the stated sources and found no record. Not proof of absence.
claim_states.unknown: Not assessed, or could not be assessed.
claim_states.conflicting: Credible sources disagree; both sides are cited.
claim_states.not-applicable: The claim does not apply (e.g. a state program that does not exist in that state).

methods.prior-edition: Carried forward from the previous edition (v3, data 2026.09.13.1) with that edition's own check date and source text. Not re-observed in the current pass unless a later claim says so.
methods.search-extract: Observed through a web search tool's extraction of the cited page. Direct page fetching was blocked in the authoring environment, so the page itself was not opened; treat as weaker than a direct reading.
methods.nppes-api: Retrieved from the CMS NPPES NPI Registry API (organization record).
methods.cms-dataset: Read from the vendored CMS Hospital General Information snapshot (October 2023; earlier snapshots for CCNs no longer listed).
methods.regulatory-inference: Follows from a cited regulation given another documented fact (e.g. CAH conditions of participation require 24-hour emergency services).
methods.manual-review: Reconciled by the maintainer from the cited sources.
methods.derived: Computed by the build from other claims.
methods.rule-based: Assigned by a documented rule applied to the cited sources; the rule is written in the claim note (for example: active status from a current registry record plus a CMS listing, or coordinates where two independent sources agree).

census_snapshot.source: CMS Hospital General Information, October 2023 snapshot (archived copy via klocey/hospitals-data-archive)
census_snapshot.note: Reference for CCN, CMS name, hospital type, ownership and bed count. Some rows last appear in older snapshots (their as_of month says so). The current CMS dataset (data.cms.gov xubh-q36u) could not be retrieved in the October 2026 pass; refreshing it is an open item.

geography_note: County/borough is derived from the coordinates against generalised 2017 Census boundaries. Coordinates are checked against the named state's polygon with a 3-mile tolerance for generalised coastlines. A point inside the right county is not proof that it sits on the right campus.

road_networks.contiguous-us: Road network of the contiguous United States (includes Whidbey and Camano Islands by bridge).
road_networks.ak-railbelt: Alaska road system connecting Anchorage, Mat-Su, the Kenai Peninsula, Fairbanks and Valdez. Treated as separate from contiguous-us: the cross-border road route is not modelled as an acute transfer.
road_networks.isolated: ak-isolated:<community> — a community with no road link to any other hospital in the dataset (local roads at most); reached by air, or seasonally by sea or river.
road_networks.ferry: <community>-ferry — reached from other hospitals' road networks only by ferry. Ground transfer is not modelled across a ferry; campuses in the same community share its local roads.
road_networks.unknown: Not documented; ground transfer is shown as unavailable.

certification_definitions.CSC: Comprehensive Stroke Center (Joint Commission; DNV; ACHC).
certification_definitions.TSC: Thrombectomy-Capable Stroke Center (Joint Commission; ACHC). DNV's Primary Stroke Center Plus (PSC+) is shown on this tier and named as such.
certification_definitions.PSC: Primary Stroke Center, including Joint Commission Advanced Primary Stroke Center (Joint Commission; DNV; ACHC; CIHQ).
certification_definitions.ASR: Acute Stroke Ready Hospital (Joint Commission 'Acute Stroke Ready Hospital'; DNV, ACHC, CIHQ equivalents).
certification_definitions.EVT: Endovascular thrombectomy. Recorded as its own documented capability, separately from any certification tier. '24/7' only when explicitly documented or entailed by a current credential, which is named.
